verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਏ।
verses.translit_en: satigur teerath jaaneeaai aThasaTh teerath saranee aae|

en.bdb: The true Guru is that pilgrimages centre in whose shelter are the sixty-eight pilgrimage centres of the Hindus.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਉ ਅਭੇਉ ਹੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਦੇਵ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵ ਤਰਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: satigur dheau abheau hai hor dhev gur sev taraae|

en.bdb: Being beyond dualities, the true a Guru is the supreme God and other gods get across the world ocean only by serving Him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਲਖ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਸੁਹਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: satigur paaras parasiaai lakh paaras paa khaak suhaae|

en.bdb: The true Guru is that philosopher's stone the dust of whose feet adorns millions of philosopher's stones.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਰਿਜਾਤੁ ਪਾਰਜਾਤ ਲਖ ਸਫਲ ਧਿਆਏ।
verses.translit_en: satigur pooraa paarijaat paarajaat lakh safal dhiaae|

en.bdb: The true Guru is that perfect wish-fulfilling tree who is meditated upon by the millions of wish-fulfilling trees.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: sukh saagar satigur purakh ratan padhaarath sikh sunaae|

en.bdb: The true Guru being ocean of delights distributes pearls in the form of different sermons.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣੀ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਕਰਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: chi(n)taaman satigur charan chi(n)taamanee achi(n)t karaae|

en.bdb: The feet of the true Guru are that desire fulfilling fabulous gem (chintamani) which makes myriads of gems free of anxieties.
Except the true Guru (God) all other is duality (which makes one go the cycle of transmigration).
